fixture_purpose: Demonstrates that provider_session_resurrection is universally blocked at Phase 0/pre-4, so the attach-receipt-before-prompt_sent path cannot be triggered. Phase 4 per-adapter enablement requires this fixture to be superseded with runtime evidence.

evidence.mechanism: mode == 'provider_session_resurrection' returns -32010 provider_session_resurrection_unsupported before eligibility check, before DB write, before any background worker dispatch, and before any attach receipt path.
evidence.hold_predicate_prevented: No provider_session_resurrection request can reach prompt_sent or provider_send ledger write at Phase 0/pre-4. The hold condition (resurrection → prompt_sent before durable attach receipt) cannot be triggered.
evidence.deferred_evidence: Phase 4 per-adapter enablement requires both the unsupported-adapter fixture and the attach-receipt fixture to be superseded with real runtime evidence before resurrection is enabled per adapter.
